prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: decorative website section BACKGROUND ONLY. Reference: the attached BabyCity product carousel screenshot. Generate a wide landscape 3:2 premium photorealistic soft 3D nursery background, matching the screenshot's cream, blush, sage and turquoise atmosphere. Composition IMPORTANT: most of the whole image must be nearly empty warm off-white, especially the left half and bottom 70%, to overlay readable text and four real product cards using HTML. At the top right (between 55%-82% width) show a very cute realistic beige plush teddy bear peeking above a large pale coral rounded rainbow arch, with a pale sage arch behind it and small soft white cloud sculptures at its sides; crop the top of the sage arch naturally at the top edge. Small pale pink heart outlines as subtle accents near the bear. At the far left edge below middle-height, a very cropped out-of-focus blush wooden stacking toy and a hint of a tiny plant, never extend more than 5% of image width into the canvas. Bottom center and right almost entirely empty ivory with a very soft warm glow. Gentle diffused daylight, realistic plush textile, premium soft editorial product photography, highly polished, no harsh outlines. NO text, NO letters, NO UI, NO cards, NO products, NO strollers, NO logos, NO watermarks. This is only a supporting ambient backdrop; it must not look like a screenshot.
